name: Mount Yotei (羊蹄山) by the Makkari trail
why: Hokkaido's 'Ezo Fuji': a long straight climb up a perfect cone through birch and stone pine to a crater 700 m wide, with the Niseko range and Lake Toya below.
book: Free, no permit. Start from Yotei Nature Park in Makkari (campground, parking); Donan buses between Rusutsu and Kutchan stop at Yotei Shizen Koen Iriguchi. Sign the climbers' book at the trailhead.
water: Drinkable spring (Yotei no Wakimizu) at the nature park only; nothing on the mountain. Carry 2.5-3 litres.
dangers: Weather turns fast on the open upper cone: walkers have died of hypothermia in summer. Carry rain gear and a warm layer.
Over 1,600 m of climb on steep, rooty and then loose volcanic ground: a very long day.
Snow lingers into June and comes back in late September; brown bears live on the lower slopes.
turnaround: Not at the 9th station by 11:30, or cloud and wind on the rim: rest at the Yotei hut and go down; the descent takes 3-4 hours.

points.name: Makkari trailhead
points.note: About 400 m, at the top of Yotei Nature Park, 30 minutes on a forest road from the campground. Sign in and climb straight into the forest.

points.name: Makkari 6th station
points.note: 1,321 m, about 2.5 hours up: the trees thin out and the view opens south over Makkari's fields and Lake Toya.

points.name: Yotei crater rim
points.note: 1,898 m, the highest point, on the east rim of the Chichigama crater, 700 m wide and 200 m deep: you reach the rim 30 minutes above the 9th station hut and walk round its south side. The full rim loop takes 80 minutes.
